asked_by: Rusty, 18:52: 'Make your recommended changes, consider any perceived bugs a feature.'
builds_on: commons_swarm_v1 (PREREG 80dac0f0..., AMENDMENT_1 dbcd5321..., results 1a18349b...). Written after seeing v1's results; that is the point of v2.
unchanged_from_v1: world (32x32, 6 patches, seasons every 150 steps, noise 0.25), energy (eat 0.2, metabolism 0.025 per AMENDMENT_1), constitution witness rule, commons-granted births (every 25 steps, period harvest > 1.0, world stock >= 50%), jubilee (1%/step), grace every 10 steps for the longest dweller (>= 15 steps), seeds 0..19, all outcomes scored from the world only.

v1_surprises_turned_into_features.herding (love as one copied map sent kin: SPACING: love knows where kin are. A keeper choosing a target scores each cell as belief - 0.3 x (kin within 1 cell of it). Love now spreads the family instead of piling it up.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.closing love helped late harvest: WEANING: the young lean on the family map, adults on their own eyes. Map weight = 0.2 x exp(-age/100), floor 0.02. Love itself never closes (sharing never stops); only the copying fades with experience.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.keeping a record helped: covered by WEANING and SPACING (both reduce copying without any record of wrongs; kin marks still count in full).
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.dwelling stood still 40% of the time on: DWELL WHERE IT MATTERS: an agent dwells only on a cell where it sees food (obs > 0.05). Dwelling on empty ground turns it into a scouting step that turn. Dwellers become keepers of a patch and witnesses for kin.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.no division of labor: ROLES: one member in three (by birth order, id % 3 == 0) is a scout. Scouts head for the least-known cell of the family map within radius 6 (lowest confidence) instead of the richest.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.a discovery could not enter the map with: CALL FOR WITNESS: a keeper with nothing good in view (best belief within radius <= 0.1) goes to its family's newest pending mark with value > 0.3, to confirm it. Nothing vouches for itself; discovery summons a witness.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.LONE won through more households each ea: BUDDING: at each birth check, a family with more than 10 members buds: its higher-id half forms a new household with a copy of the map and the same constitution. More households, more commons-granted births, still capped by the >= 50% world-stock rule.
v1_surprises_turned_into_features.grace only rescued stuck dwellers: GRACE toward the frontier: the released agent heads for its family's most recently confirmed mark (kin's latest discovery) instead of the oldest best cell.

variants.V2_LONE: v2 movement rules, but every agent its own family of one (own marks accepted directly, newborns inherit nothing, no budding needed)
variants.NO_WEANING: V2_FULL with map weight fixed at 0.2
variants.V2_NO_CONSTITUTION: V2_FULL with self-vouched marks (direct write; CALL FOR WITNESS has nothing to answer)
variants.V2_SELF_REPLICATING: V2_FULL with self-authorized splitting at energy > 2.0 and no commons check (no budding)

outcomes: same as v1 (harvest_total, harvest_late, post_shift, stock_min, pop_final, pop_peak, families_alive = founding lineages alive, map_error, stuck_frac) plus per_capita = harvest / agent-steps.

predictions.D2: V2_FULL harvest_total >= V2_LONE harvest_total AND V2_FULL per_capita >= V2_LONE per_capita (with tasking, the family beats the individual).
predictions.D4: NO_ROLES post_shift < V2_FULL post_shift (scouts find the moved patches).
predictions.scoring: means over 20 seeds; seeds agreeing in sign reported alongside, not scored

reporting_rule: All variants, outcomes and seeds reported. PASS/FAIL as frozen. Constants above set before code and not tuned afterwards. No calibration run is allowed in v2.
